reference_memory.normal_pattern: The normal pattern is a perfectly flat, zero-valued line across all scales, indicating complete absence of variation. All four reference candidates exhibit identical morphology: robust-standardized values are exactly 0.0 at every point, with no detectable noise, slope, curvature, or amplitude modulation. The period is effectively infinite (no oscillation), stability is maximal (zero roughness, zero MAD), and baseline is fixed at 0.0. Peaks and troughs are absent—there are no local extrema beyond the constant level. This reflects a stationary, deterministic zero-signal segment after robust standardization, likely corresponding to a quiescent operational mode in the NASA-SMAP D-8 channel. Acceptable variation is strictly zero; any deviation—however small—in future queries would constitute an anomaly. The consistency across 1P, 3P, and 5P windows confirms that the flatness is not an artifact of window length but an intrinsic property of the underlying normal behavior. No trend, seasonality, or transient structure is present; the signal is identically null over hundreds to thousands of points.
